scope: Read-only review of public GrabFood Singapore content for up to five existing SFA directory rows with blank Menu / Price and Menu URL fields. GrabFood's indexed public Genki Sushi chain page lists the chain's Singapore locations and a chain-level popular-items menu. The branch names, addresses, units and postcodes cross-match five SFA rows exactly. The platform exposes a shared chain page, not independently verified branch-specific menu pages, so no delivery item or price is assigned to a specific SFA branch in this proposal.

sources.name: GrabFood Singapore Genki Sushi public chain page (search-indexed; direct fetch returned HTTP 403)
sources.evidence_access: Search-indexed page content reviewed on 2026-10-19; direct page open returned 403 Forbidden.
sources.source_page_content: Lists named Genki Sushi branches with addresses/units and displays a chain-level 'most popular menu' with item names and prices.
sources.limitations: Chain-level menu and pricing are not demonstrated as outlet-specific. Current delivery availability and prices may vary by location, time, promotions, and delivery configuration. Search indexing can lag. No images or descriptions reused; no account access, order, or paid service used.

limitations: The popular-item list is chain-level and is not safely attributable to any one outlet; no menu items/prices are proposed for SFA branches.
The chain page is a delivery-platform listing, not an official dine-in menu. Delivery and promotional prices are volatile and can differ from in-store prices.
GrabFood's page was accessible through public search indexing, but direct open returned 403 Forbidden; source extraction is limited to the indexed content.
No images, platform descriptions, ratings, opening hours, closure status, or public-access status are proposed.
No account login, order, paid feature, or Mapbox request was used.
